Most candidates understood that the tasks were to describe a period of part time work to earn money for a
holiday and to say how they spent that holiday, in each case giving impressions. A minority said they spent
the whole school holiday working, which suggested they had not read or had perhaps misunderstood the top
line of the rubric. Others, perhaps taking travail to mean ‘travel’, wrote exclusively about the holiday, omitting
